title: Faster, Smoother & More Robust
changes: Test questions, autofill, character breakdowns, example sentences, and translation feedback are now noticeably faster
Note parsing, interactive lessons, and story generation respond quicker too
High-quality Mandarin pronunciation via neural text-to-speech, with browser speech as a fallback
Community lessons now show the author's lesson context, with a more compact card grid
Streaks and daily goals now respect your local timezone instead of the server's
Rating a card Hard no longer resets it like a miss — it halves the interval and keeps your progress
Cards you've lapsed on recover their interval more gradually instead of restarting from scratch
Reviews, XP, and streaks are saved atomically so a double-tap or flaky connection can't lose progress
Interactive lesson answers are graded server-side, and your last answer on a page is now reliably saved
The Review badge and lesson list update immediately after finishing a lesson or editing a card
Finish a review session and jump straight into a lesson with one tap
Deleting a story now asks for confirmation first
Empty Courses and Stories pages now show a clear next step
Keyboard and screen-reader improvements across flashcards, tabs, and audio buttons
Security hardening: ownership checks on lesson links, rate limits on AI features, and safer error messages
